US Visa Interview Delays Impact Indian Students' Plans

Indian students are experiencing delays in US visa interviews, disrupting their university admissions. A temporary pause in appointments has led some students to defer their university admissions. Consequently, many are considering alternative study destinations such as the UK and Europe. The situation has raised concerns about the US's ability to retain international talent.
